summary.text: Amanda Farías represents the 18th District on the New York City Council, which includes Castle Hill, Clason Point, Harding Park, Parkchester, Unionport, Soundview and Westchester Square in the Bronx.
Her Council biography says she is in her second and final term and served as Majority Leader of the Council from January 2024 to January 2026.

paragraphs.text: Farías is a second-generation Afro-Latina of Puerto Rican and Dominican descent who was raised in Soundview, according to her Council biography.
She attended P.S. 69X, Holy Cross School and Preston High School, and earned a bachelor's and a master's degree in government and politics from St. John's University.
She spent her formative years in after-school and summer programs at the Kips Bay Boys and Girls Club.
